title: Sample 12-6: Sidebars at Beginning of a Lesson (Print Only)

illustrates.quote: Add box lines for clarity if the content of the sidebar interrupts the flow of text. (See Formats, §7, Boxed Material.) (Sample 12-5: Sidebar with Student Activity on page 12-9 and Sample 12-6: Sidebars at Beginning of a Lesson on page 12-10.)

blocks.features: Small heading on a yellow tab, above the main title.
Large orange title, wraps to two print lines ('Following the' / 'Dietary Guidelines') purely for layout -- one heading.
Instructional callout with an arrow pointing from the space between the two sidebars to the start of the main paragraph, 'Think of an ideal day.'

blocks.title: You will learn . . .
blocks.features: Small boxed callout, cream background, red heading and bullets.

items.text: how to identify types and sources of nutrients.
how to use the Dietary Guidelines.
how to use the Food Guide Pyramid.
how to distinguish between foods that are healthful and those that do not contain many nutrients.

blocks.title: Vocabulary
blocks.features: Small boxed callout directly below 'You will learn . . .', cream background, red heading and bullets; each term is followed by its glossary page reference.
Bulleted list; each item is a term followed by a page reference.

blocks.text: Think of an ideal day. You might read a few chapters of a book, go in-line skating, see a movie with a friend, and have dinner with your family. Such a day includes a balance of activities. You need balance in your diet as well. A wide variety of healthful choices in your diet enables you to look and feel your best.
blocks.features: Set in a large bold font, beside a photograph of a girl in rollerblading gear.

print.notes: The two stacked sidebars ('You will learn . . .' and 'Vocabulary') sit at the lower left of the page, below the lesson title and to the left of the large opening paragraph; a single '(Formats: Suggested Location)' callout and arrow point from between them to the start of that paragraph.
print.printFeatures: Lesson-opener page: a small 'LESSON 1' tab, a large two-line title, two stacked boxed sidebars at lower left, a large-font opening paragraph at centre/right beside a full-height photograph, and the print page number 'B44' at bottom left.

braille.notes: Captioned '(Print Only)' in the source -- no braille transcription exists for this sample.

resolution: Both runs agree on wording throughout. Run B's pdfPages included both 350 and 351; run A's included only 350. Re-rendering the PDF page range directly (references/bana/braille-formats-2016.pdf, pp.350-351 at 400dpi) confirms p.351 (printed page 12-11) is a blank divider page with no content at all -- run A is correct; run B's own summary.md even says the same thing ('PDF page 351 ... is a blank divider ... pdfPages array was properly adjusted to reflect only the page with content'), so this was a slip in run B's actual JSON, not a genuine disagreement. List items are given as proper 'items' arrays per this task's schema (run B already did this for both lists; run A used a single newline-joined string, reconciled here to match).
